snippet.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 2 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Available October 13 on PS4, PS3, Xbox One, Steam and Amazon Fire TV! For 1-10,000 players! That’s right, you can play with 10,000 people using our Audience Mode. Your phones or tablets are your controllers! Five outrageous party games (Fibbage 2, Earwax, Quiplash XL, Bomb Corp and Bidiots) for one low price! http://jackboxgames.com/project/jbpp2/

Xbox http://bit.ly/1La28wf
Steam http://bit.ly/1La2eEb
Amazon Fire TV http://amzn.to/1NbKj0s
